Safety & Efficiency In One Pool Cover

Automatic pool covers offer enhanced pool safety, heat retention, cleanliness, and reduced chemical usage when compared to any other type of pool cover.

Benefits Of Automatic Pool Covers

Installing an automatic swimming pool cover in Ontario comes with massive benefits
Enhanced SafetyKeep your pool secure at all times. Giving yourself the ultimate peace of mind.
Pool CleanlinessKeep debris like leaves, sticks, insects and much more out of your pool, reducing cleaning times.
Reduced Chemical Usage

Reduce your pool's exposure to the elements protecting your waters sanitizing abilities.

Heat RetentionPrevent heat loss through evaporation and keep your swimming pool covered with ease.

The Cover-Pools Difference

Cover-Pools invented the automatic pool cover in 1962 and has been perfecting the system ever since while maintaining a longstanding track record of quality, durability, and customer service.

Superior Engineering
Coverpools motors and mechanisms are engineered to be the toughest on the market.
Simplified Controls

Controlling your Cover-Pools automatic pool cover is as easy as pressing a button or turning a key.
Quality Fabrics

Choose from a selection of quality fabric colours to make your automatic cover yours.
Durable Tracks
Durable and versatile track systems are designed to cover virtually any pool shape.

Custom Made To Your Pool Shape

Our automatic pool covers are custom-built to fit your swimming pool, regardless of shape or size. We provide you with a variety of deck designs and cover options to enhance your pool.

Introducing The "T4" Advanced Cover System

The New T4™ is the first and only autocover system designed to utilize stainless steel cables. Providing incredible durability, longevity and greater flexibility, while installing in a smaller footprint for a seamless integration into the pool design.
